Adds abstract base value types from ContainerAnalysis and returns their IDs as a String array.
Adds a class to the mapping, skipping primitives, handling arrays, interfaces (abstract or value), exceptions, and other value types via analysis and add methods.

Checks if the JTS attribute is defined in the transactions subsystem and returns its boolean value, defaulting to false if missing or the resource is not found.

Collects all component class names from web metadata, shared and specific TLDs, and async listeners into a set.

Builds a map of operation IDL names to their analyses by adding all operations and any attribute accessor/mutator analyses.
Collects metrics for a resource and returns a MetricRegistration.
Builds a WSEndpointDeploymentUnit using the server integration classloader, then restores the original classloader.

Starts a web application for a deployment, waiting for endpoint services to stabilize if not in a service, then launches the app and returns its context root and endpoints.

Elects a new lock manager by acquiring a distributed lock, iterating through registered nodes to find an active one, updating the configuration, and returning the chosen server.

Commit micro-transaction: validate active and balanced, decrement level, finalize when level reaches zero.

Deletes all records in recordOperations from the local cache after a rollback.

Runs a query with a limit of one and returns the first result or null.
Creates a file by acquiring a write lock, obtaining exclusive access, opening the channel, initializing, setting the version, initializing allocation mode, and then releasing the lock.
Checks that a requested byte range is within file bounds, throws if not, and returns the offset adjusted by header size.

Executes a command request, handling live queries and async mode, and returns the result.
Flushes and releases the write lock on the given network channel if it is not null.

Initiates a request on the given network channel with the specified command and session, then returns the channel.

Retrieve connection by ID, set its protocol if found, and return it.
Interrupts the network manager, disconnects the client, and sends a shutdown signal via the protocol.
Soft shuts down the protocol of the connection with the given channel ID if it exists.
Disconnects a client connection by id, cleans up resources, triggers callbacks, and returns true only if no other connections of the same protocol remain.
Pushes a serialized configuration to all connected clients that support legacy push messages over the binary protocol, acquiring a write lock, sending the data, and handling timeouts and errors.
Swaps the value at the specified index with newValue, returning true if successful.
Closes the lock manager by releasing all record locks (write or read) and clearing the lock map.

Sets context input from args and delegates execution to execute(request, context, progressListener).

Adds an index definition to the list, enforces at most one multi‑value index, and updates the collate configuration.

Returns the stored string, unescaping escaped backticks if present, or null if the value is null.
Xorshift RNG step: shift and XOR probe, update thread-local probe, return new value.
Deletes a cluster by ID if no class references it, clears related command cache, drops the cluster, and returns true on success.
Builds an ODocument from a JSON file at the given path, returning null if the path is null or the file does not exist.

Adds a vertex attribute strategy to the internal map and returns the reader instance.
Adds an edge attribute strategy to the map and returns the reader.
Return a list of newly created record operations, optionally filtered by a given class and its subclasses if polymorphic.
Return all CREATED record operations, optionally filtering by the supplied cluster IDs.
Adds or updates transaction index changes for a given key, handling clear operations, recording per-key modifications, and tracking record-level index operations.

Processes a record by applying a filter, updating its fields (content, merge, set, increment, add, put, remove), handling edge updates, marking it dirty, saving it if any changes occurred, and returning true.
Determines if an indexable SQL function can run inline without an index, given target, operator, right operand, context, and parameters.
Converts a single key or collection of keys into a set of Comparable values using the index definition.
Synchronously writes a page to the cache, updates timestamps and last written info, and flushes the cache when its size exceeds the buffer threshold.
Reads a page by returning its byte array from the last written buffer, cache, or file, updating access time and synchronizing access.

Opens the WAL file, truncates any partially written page, and resets cache and state variables.

Checks whether a cluster’s execution mode is synchronous, returning true, false, or null if the mode is unset or “undefined”.
Checks a cluster's READ_YOUR_WRITES setting, falls back to the global config, warns if missing, and defaults to true.

Returns the owner of a configured cluster by name, or null if the cluster or owner field is missing.
Returns a list of server names for the given cluster, or null if none.
Retrieves the set of registered server names from the configuration document.
